meta.name: Splinter Cell Deathwatch
meta.description: In the shadowy world of espionage, Sam Fisher is a rumor and a legend. Pulled back into action, he must help a new recruit unravel a global conspiracy.

videos.title: Up from the Grave
videos.overview: When a covert agent's mission to extract an asset from a dire situation goes sideways, a hero from the past is called on to lend a hand.

videos.title: Dinner First, Talk Later
videos.overview: After inheriting her father's company, Displace CEO Diana Shetland faces challenges — and new opportunities. Fisher moves McKenna to a secure location.

videos.title: Welcome to the 4th Echelon
videos.overview: Grim swallows her pride and seeks help from a Canadian hacker. Diana presents her vision. Fisher makes a house call.

videos.title: Scars of Bagram
videos.overview: Fisher and McKenna make a dramatic exit. An '80s pop song reveals a vital clue. Fisher's turbulent past comes further into focus.

videos.title: Simple as That
videos.overview: While undercover at a glitzy gala, Fisher and McKenna search for a way to access the droves of data on Diana's phone.

videos.title: The Man Is the Mission
videos.overview: With McKenna in extreme danger, Fisher ignores orders and goes rogue. Meanwhile, Diana and Charlie struggle to mask their mutual contempt.

videos.title: Chaos Theory (1)
videos.overview: Fisher and Diana lay their cards on the table. McKenna gets back in the game. Grim and Jo face a hard deadline — and a growing sense of dread.

videos.title: Chaos Theory (2)
videos.overview: Fisher and McKenna board an eerily empty ship in hopes of staving off catastrophe, while Diana learns that even her plans are subject to change.
